title: 2013 Topps Legends in the Making Ed Reed NFLPA Houston Texans Safety LM-ER
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2013 Topps Legends in the Making Ed Reed NFLPA Houston Texans Safety LM-ER trading card is a must-have for any football fan. Featuring an insert design, this sports trading card showcases the talented Ed Reed, who played for the Houston Texans team in the National Football League (NFL). 

With a card number of LM-ER, this trading card is a great addition to any collection. The card is not autographed and is from the 2013 Topps set. As a part of the Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop category, this trading card is perfect for any sports trading card enthusiast.
